name: What factors influence the overall cost of a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the overall cost of a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary significantly based on square footage, foundation requirements, structural complexity, and finish selections such as custom tile, trim, and paint. An addition involving running plumbing lines for a master suite or attached bathroom costs more than a standard family room expansion. Because Abraham Becerra operates HH Remodeling as a hands-on general contractor without large corporate overhead, our internal crew completes the framing, drywall, and finish work directly, which helps keep overall project costs reasonable and predictable throughout construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Total costs depend on square footage, foundation needs, plumbing or electrical tie-ins, structural framing, and chosen finish materials like tile and trim.
